function.name: goto_coords
function.description: Walk/path to a specific (x, y, z) block coordinate in the current dimension.

function.name: goto_block
function.description: PATH ONLY — walks toward the nearest cached block; does NOT break or mine it. Never use this for ores or trees you want harvested; use mine() with the ore block ids instead.

function.name: mine
function.description: Mine and break blocks (digs ores, logs, etc.) and STOP at quantity. THIS is the tool for 'mine N logs' or 'get N <block>': e.g. mine(['minecraft:log'], 67) gathers 67 logs and stops — it does NOT craft anything. If quantity is 0 or omitted, mining never stops by count (use a number when the goal gives one). For diamond (and other overworld ores), pass the stone ore id: deepslate variants are added automatically.

blocks.description: Block ids to mine, e.g. ['minecraft:diamond_ore'] (deepslate_diamond_ore is auto-included).

quantity.description: Total stop quantity across all listed blocks. 0 or omit for unlimited.

function.name: follow_player
function.description: Follow a player by name. Useful for being escorted.

function.name: farm
function.description: Automatically farm nearby crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, melons, pumpkins, etc.).

function.name: explore
function.description: Wander outward from current position, discovering chunks. Do not use unless the player explicitly asks to explore. If the player says not to explore, this tool is blocked for that goal.

function.name: build_schematic
function.description: Build a schematic from the schematics folder, optionally at given coords.

name.description: Schematic file name (with or without extension).

function.name: tune
function.description: PREFERRED when the player describes how Baritone should move/aim/break in plain English. Pass the player's words verbatim; deterministic matching applies the right setting cluster and saves it. Understands: 'head not turning / won't break blocks / fix aim', 'stealthy/undercover/legit', 'smoother look', 'snappy aim', 'break faster/slower', 'allow breaking / don't break'. Returns exactly what changed, or a help text if nothing matched (then use set_setting).

request.description: The player's tuning request in their own words.

function.name: set_setting
function.description: Change a Baritone/AI setting at runtime. Validates the name and value, then confirms the applied value, e.g. allowBreak=true. Use list_settings to discover valid names. The API key is protected and cannot be set.

function.name: list_settings
function.description: List Baritone/AI settings the agent can tune. With no filter, returns settings currently changed from their defaults. With a filter substring, searches every setting's NAME and DOCUMENTATION (e.g. 'break', 'look', 'sprint'), returning each match with a short doc snippet.

filter.description: Optional substring to search names and docs for, e.g. 'break'.

function.name: get_setting
function.description: Get one setting's full documentation, current value, type, and default value.

function.name: reset_setting
function.description: Reset one setting back to its default value.

function.name: get_ender_chest
function.description: Open the player's ender chest and read its REAL contents as item -> count. Opens a reachable ender chest, or PLACES one from inventory if none is nearby, then looks inside. Falls back to last-known contents if it cannot open or place one. Use before planning crafting that relies on stored items.

function.name: open_station
function.description: Open a station GUI. Opens a reachable one within 6 blocks, ELSE places one from your inventory right next to you and opens that (so it's never far away). Only travels to a distant cached station if you have none nearby and no item to place. Supported: crafting_table, furnace, blast_furnace, smoker, brewing_stand, stonecutter, smithing_table, anvil. (Have the station's item in inventory for the place-here path.)

function.name: equip_item
function.description: Equip/select an item from inventory or hotbar into the selected hotbar slot.

item_id.description: Item id, e.g. minecraft:bucket or diamond_pickaxe.

function.name: right_click
function.description: Right-click with the currently held item, using the current crosshair target if there is one.

function.name: find_entities
function.description: Scan for nearby entities (villagers, traders, mobs, animals, players) and list each with its type id, name, position and distance. Use this to locate NPCs before interacting or attacking. Optionally filter by a type/name substring (e.g. 'villager', 'trader').

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against type id OR name (e.g. 'villager', 'wandering', 'cow'). Omit to list everything nearby.

function.name: interact_entity
function.description: Walk to the nearest matching entity and RIGHT-CLICK it (opens villager/trader trades, etc.). Match by type id and/or name. For attacking instead, the survival reflexes handle hostiles; use run_command if you need a different action.

entity_type.description: Entity type id or substring, e.g. 'minecraft:villager', 'villager', 'wandering_trader' (optional if name given).

entity_name.description: Display name / name-tag substring to match, case-insensitive (optional if type given).

max_wait_seconds.description: Cap for walking to the entity (default 90, max 300).

function.name: use_item_on_block
function.description: Equip an optional item, then use the held item on the nearest matching block within a small radius.

block_id.description: Block id to use the held item on.

item_id.description: Optional item id to equip before using.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Escape hatch: run any raw Baritone chat-control command (without the prefix). Use this for anything not covered by the other tools (e.g. 'cancel', 'thisway 100', 'sel 1', 'waypoints save base', etc.).

command.description: The raw command, e.g. 'goto 100 64 -200' or 'mine diamond_ore'.

function.name: make_wooden_tool
function.description: MAKE a wooden pickaxe or axe FROM SCRATCH, only when you have NONE. Gathers a few logs if needed, then crafts planks, sticks, table, places it and crafts the tool — one call. This is NOT for gathering logs: to get N logs use mine(['minecraft:log'], N). If you already hold any pickaxe/axe (any tier), do NOT call this.

tool.description: REQUIRED: exactly minecraft:wooden_pickaxe OR minecraft:wooden_axe (aliases: pickaxe, pick, axe).

function.name: make_wood_tool_from_logs
function.description: ONE-SHOT early-game crafting: from logs in inventory, crafts planks, sticks, crafting table, places the table, opens it, and crafts a wooden axe OR pickaxe. Closes chest UIs first. Sets allowInventory true. Prefer this over run_command for tools.

tool.description: minecraft:wooden_pickaxe or minecraft:wooden_axe (preferred); or pickaxe / wooden_axe / axe aliases.

function.name: close_inventory_screens
function.description: Close chest, hopper, furnace, etc. Leave survival inventory or crafting table when appropriate.

function.name: craft_planks_from_logs
function.description: Craft planks from logs using the 2x2 player crafting grid. Open inventory (E) first.

max_logs.description: How many logs to convert this call (default 8).

function.name: craft_crafting_table
function.description: Craft one crafting table from four planks in the 2x2 grid. Open inventory (E) first.

function.name: craft_sticks
function.description: Craft sticks from two planks (vertical pattern) in the 2x2 grid. Open inventory (E) first.

sets.description: How many stick recipes to run (default 1).

function.name: craft_wooden_axe_at_table
function.description: Craft a wooden axe in an OPEN crafting table GUI (3 planks + 2 sticks pattern).

function.name: craft_wooden_pickaxe_at_table
function.description: Craft a wooden pickaxe in an OPEN crafting table GUI (right-click a placed table). Needs 3 planks + 2 sticks.

function.name: craft_shaped_at_table
function.description: Craft any shaped 3x3 recipe at an OPEN crafting table: pass grid as 9 strings in row-major order (top row cells 0-2, then middle, then bottom). Empty cells: "" or "air". Each cell may be an item id (minecraft:oak_planks), or a tag like #minecraft:planks. Example stone pickaxe: ["cobblestone","cobblestone","cobblestone","","stick","","","stick",""].

grid.description: Exactly 9 strings: item id, #namespace:tag, or empty for that cell.

function.name: craft_recipe_at_table
function.description: Craft using a RECIPE ID at an OPEN crafting table. Tries PlacementInfo first, then centered shaped pattern, then bounded shapeless slot search — many datapack/mod recipes work without manual grids. Singleplayer: full recipe manager; multiplayer: synced registry only.

function.name: list_craftable_table_recipes
function.description: With crafting table GUI open: lists recipe ids you likely have materials for (inventory simulation). Returns placeable_recipes (good PlacementInfo) and needs_pattern_or_shapeless_fallback lines. Use before craft_recipe_at_table when the recipe id is unknown. Multiplayer may list fewer recipes.

max_entries.description: Max total ids across both lines (default 50, max 200).

filter.description: Optional substring filter on recipe id (case-insensitive).

function.name: list_crafting_recipes_for_output
function.description: With player inventory or crafting table GUI open: list craftable recipe ids that produce an output item.

output_item_id.description: Desired output item id, e.g. minecraft:stick.

max_entries.description: Max recipe ids to return (default 50, max 100).

function.name: craft_item
function.description: Craft by desired output item id using the currently open inventory (2x2) or crafting table (3x3). Use open_station(crafting_table) first for 3x3 recipes.

output_item_id.description: Desired output item id, e.g. minecraft:iron_pickaxe.

quantity.description: How many craft operations to attempt (default 1, max 64).

function.name: craft_recipe_in_inventory
function.description: Like craft_recipe_at_table but uses the 2x2 grid in OPEN player inventory (E). Only recipes that fit in four cells.

function.name: craft_shaped_in_inventory
function.description: 2x2 shaped crafting in OPEN inventory: exactly 4 item ids row-major (top row then bottom). Empty: "" or air.

function.name: furnace_smelt
function.description: With an OPEN furnace, smoker, or blast furnace GUI: put one input item in the input slot, optionally one fuel, wait for output, shift-click result. Vanilla campfires have no GUI. Optional recipe_id validates input against a smelting/blasting/smoking recipe.

input_item_id.description: Item id to smelt one of, e.g. minecraft:raw_iron.

fuel_item_id.description: Optional fuel item id (omit or empty if fuel already present).

recipe_id.description: Optional smelting recipe id to validate input (e.g. minecraft:iron_ingot).

max_wait_seconds.description: Wait cap for each output (default 90, max 600).

quantity.description: How many outputs to collect (default 1, max 64).

function.name: smithing_recipe
function.description: Smithing table with OPEN GUI: resolves a RecipeType smithing recipe id, places template/base/addition, shift-clicks result.

recipe_id.description: Smithing recipe id (upgrade or trim), as in /recipe give.

function.name: stonecutter_cut
function.description: Stonecutter: OPEN GUI, pass stonecutter recipe id; deposits matching input from inventory, selects recipe, takes output.

function.name: anvil_combine
function.description: Anvil: OPEN GUI. Places left item and optional right item (materials), optional rename string, shift-clicks result.

new_name.description: Optional rename text (omit if not renaming).

function.name: brewing_load_stand
function.description: Brewing stand: OPEN GUI. Puts blaze powder in fuel slot if empty, ingredient in ingredient slot, water bottles into empty potion columns (0–2). Does not wait for brew ticks.

ingredient_item_id.description: Item id for top ingredient slot (e.g. minecraft:nether_wart).

function.name: brewing_brew
function.description: Brewing stand: OPEN GUI. Loads the stand, waits for the brew to finish, and optionally shift-clicks bottles out.

ingredient_item_id.description: Item id for top ingredient slot (e.g. minecraft:nether_wart).

max_wait_seconds.description: Wait cap for brew completion (default 90, max 600).

collect.description: Whether to shift-click bottle slots after brewing (default true).

function.name: set_goal_plan
function.description: For #goal plan mode: set the side-HUD todo plan before doing actions. Use 3-8 concrete steps.

steps.description: Todo steps to show on the HUD.

function.name: update_goal_status
function.description: Update the side-HUD with the current short status.

function.name: complete_goal_step
function.description: Mark a one-based side-HUD plan step complete and optionally update status.

step_index.description: One-based step index to mark complete.

function.name: mission_enqueue
function.description: Queue another independent AI mission to run after the current mission finishes.

plan_mode.description: Whether the queued mission should use the side-HUD plan mode (default true).

function.name: mission_status
function.description: Show the active mission and pending mission queue.

function.name: mission_pause
function.description: Pause the mission queue so pending missions do not auto-start. The current agent continues its current turn.

function.name: mission_resume
function.description: Resume the mission queue and start the next pending mission if no agent is active.

function.name: mission_retry
function.description: Queue a retry of the last finished mission.

function.name: memory_remember
function.description: Persist a useful fact for future missions, such as base location, chest contents, player preference, or resource spot.

key.description: Stable short key, e.g. base, wood_chest, no_explore_preference.

category.description: Optional category, e.g. location, preference, resource, warning.

include_position.description: Attach the current dimension and player block position (default false).

function.name: memory_recall
function.description: Recall saved mission memory and optionally recent checkpoints.

include_checkpoints.description: Whether to include recent checkpoint matches (default false).

function.name: memory_forget
function.description: Forget one saved memory by key.

function.name: memory_checkpoint
function.description: Persist an explicit checkpoint for the current mission.

detail.description: What changed or what was learned.

status.description: Optional status, e.g. ok, blocked, warning.

function.name: stop
function.description: Cancel all current Baritone tasks and pathing.

function.name: wait_until_idle
function.description: Wait until Baritone is idle: not pathing, no path goal, and mine/farm/explore processes are inactive. Use after mine/goto/farm/explore. timeout_seconds=0 or omit = unlimited (until ai stop).

timeout_seconds.description: 0 or omit = wait until idle indefinitely (still respects ai stop). Positive = cap in seconds.

function.name: get_state
function.description: Return a snapshot: position, dimension, health, food + edible_food_count, hotbar, inventory_totals, ender_chest_totals, has_wooden_pickaxe/axe, best_pickaxe/best_axe (tier), time_of_day, ticks_until_night, is_night, light_level, mob_spawn_risk, pathing/goal, mine/farm/explore active, mission_memory_summary (known locations), recent_reflexes. Use time/light/tools/food to plan survival.

function.name: say
function.description: Print a short status message to the player's chat (visible only to them).

function.name: done
function.description: Signal that the original goal is complete or impossible. Pass a final summary. After calling this the agent loop terminates.
